user.title: Aquarium Wavemaker
user.description: Create a Toggle helper first (Settings > Devices & services > Helpers > Create helper > Toggle) and select it as the master toggle. ON lets the schedule drive the pumps; OFF stops sending, and the pumps keep their last wave. Add the integration again for a second aquarium, each with its own toggle.

pump.title: First pump
pump.description: The ESPHome action is the one your wavemaker ESP32 exposes, for example esphome.wavemaker_set_wave (see the example wavemaker.yaml). The channel is the pump's number on that ESP32, starting at 0. You can add pumps, followers and schedules in the Aquarium Wavemaker card.

error.invalid_name: Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores only (max 32 characters).

abort.already_configured: That master toggle is already used by another aquarium.

set_wave.name: Set wave
set_wave.description: Send a wave mode to a pump for testing. Not saved.

pulse.description: Seconds at the maximum per period (pulse).

fade.description: Seconds to blend into this wave.
